name: mclip
description: How-to clips of a web system from a scenario file: /mclip:init puts the recorder in the project, /mclip:record writes the scenario for a flow (with the data-tour attributes it needs) and records it with real clicks, highlights, zoom, Thai captions and a Thai voice-over, /mclip:finish lays captions and title cards over the clean video in the WeftCut editor.
